title: CI build-minute billing with charge reversals
name: Build minute billing

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code records reversals of build charges in the ledger? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A 'large' runner build lasts 61 seconds. What does priceMicros return?
chargeBuild is called twice concurrently for the same buildId. Assuming repo.insert enforces a unique txnId, what happens?
choices: Both inserts succeed, double-charging the org
One insert succeeds and the other call fails with a unique-constraint error from insert
The second call returns the existing txn because getTxn always sees it
post() rejects the second txn as unbalanced

questions.prompt: invoiceCents is given 25_001n micros. What does it return and why?
choices: 3n, because adding MICROS_PER_CENT - 1 before dividing rounds up
3n, because bigint division rounds to nearest
